legal_position_note: Private/non-distributed status reduces distribution exposure but is not treated as automatic permission to copy protected Tolkien, film, actor-likeness, prop, costume, map, dialogue or trademark material. Explicit permission/clearance is required before importing protected third-party material.

contacts.scope: The Lord of the Rings and The Hobbit licensing, including video-game-related rights handled by Middle-earth Enterprises.
contacts.project_use: Ask whether any private, non-distributed, non-monetized game-project permission or limited development license is available; do not assume approval.

contacts.scope: Concept design, game development and private commissions. Weta is not treated as the owner of all Middle-earth IP or film material.
contacts.project_use: Potential paid professional help/reference/commission if budget allows and underlying IP permissions are separately satisfied.

contacts.organization: Warner Bros. Discovery / New Line Cinema
contacts.official_route: Warner Bros. clip & still licensing; film-related enquiries are directed by Tolkien Estate/Middle-earth Enterprises to Warner Bros/New Line.
contacts.scope: Peter Jackson film-specific clips/stills and other film-derived material; exact interactive/game rights may require additional licensing coordination.
contacts.project_use: Do not copy film screenshots, actor likenesses, exact costumes/props or film audio into production without applicable permission.

contacts.scope: Tolkien writings, original artwork, maps, scripts, names/marks and other Estate-controlled material.
contacts.project_use: Use as a rights-policy reference. Do not interpret a private project as permission to reproduce protected Estate material.

contacts.scope: Permission requests for published Tolkien text/quotes and related publishing rights.
contacts.project_use: We should continue using original dialogue rather than reproducing book text unless explicit permission is obtained.

outreach_message_template.subject: Private non-distributed Middle-earth game project permissions inquiry
body_points: State that the project is personal, private, non-commercial, not publicly distributed and not monetized.
State that no ripped film/game assets, soundtrack, actor scans or copied screenplay/book dialogue will be used without permission.
Describe the requested permission narrowly: private interactive prototype, specific names/locations/visual references or specific licensed material.
Ask whether the organization offers a non-commercial/private development permission, limited license or approved resource route.
Ask which rights holder must approve any film-specific or literary-specific material outside their scope.
Do not send proprietary creative ideas unless requested; Middle-earth Enterprises explicitly advises against this in initial licensing submissions.

decision_rules: Weta Workshop approval/help does not replace Middle-earth Enterprises, Warner Bros/New Line, Tolkien Estate or HarperCollins permission where those rights apply.
Use original project-owned art and properly licensed generic assets as the default production route.
If permission is granted, store the written permission/license evidence beside the external asset manifest before importing protected material.
